artworks.title: Guinea Hen
artworks.medium: wood engraving on China paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a guinea fowl. The image shows a black and white illustration of a guinea fowl with detailed features, including its body, feathers, casque, and dotted plumage. The bird is depicted in profile on a patch of grass. The texture of the feathers and grass is created using lines and stippling. The background is plain to emphasize the bird.

artworks.title: The Boasting Traveler
artworks.medium: metalcut
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group discussion among seven men. The artwork features eight men draped in classical attire, sitting and standing in a semicircle. The scene is framed within an oval shape, with intricate linework creating texture and depth. Two men at the center are gesturing with their hands, drawing the viewer's focus. The surrounding figures appear attentive, with some seated and others slightly leaning forward. The background consists of vertical and horizontal lines, adding to the formality and structure of the composition.

artworks.title: Vue d'une rue des Faubourgs de Besançon (View of a Street in the Outskirts of Besançon)
artworks.medium: lithograph on chine collé
artworks.description: The image shows a street with buildings on both sides. The buildings' rooftops, gables, and chimneys create a jagged silhouette against the sky. Details of the buildings, such as windows, roof tiles, and brickwork, are visible. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of brown and sepia to create depth and shadow. In the foreground, figures in traditional attire are engaged in conversation or daily activities. The street recedes into the background, where the sky is dark with swirling clouds, offering contrast to the urban setting.

artworks.title: Cavalry Battle
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts horseback riders galloping energetically across a landscape. The ground slopes upwards slightly in the center, with the horizon not distinctly visible. More riders can be seen in the distance to the center and left. Intricate and detailed brushstrokes create movement through fluid lines, conveying speed and intensity. The color palette is monochromatic, with shades of black and white for strong contrast. The tumultuous sky and clouds are rendered with expressive strokes, adding atmosphere to the background.

artworks.title: View of the Remains of Caracalla's Baths, Taken from the Jesuits Gardens at Rome
artworks.artist: Richard Cooper II (artist and publisher); John Boydell (publisher)
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint in brown on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (cut within platemark): 37.8 x 52.2 cm (14 7/8 x 20 9/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts an expansive landscape with ancient ruins dominating the scene. The horizon is adorned with towering remnants of stone structures partially covered with overgrown foliage. The sky features detailed yet subtle cloud formations in gray and white tones. The brushstrokes in a monochromatic palette are crisp and finely detailed, highlighting textures of stone and vegetation. Closest to the viewer, a group of figures with animals and a cart is visible, providing scale against the ruins. In the distance, the terrain slopes upward with more ruins and sparse trees, creating a serene yet monumental atmosphere.

artworks.title: Landscape
artworks.medium: monotype on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a gently sloping terrain leading to the horizon. There is a silhouette of a tree on the right. Expressive brushstrokes capture texture and movement. The color palette is monochromatic, with shades of black and gray on a beige background. The ground appears textured and slightly rugged, resembling grass or low vegetation. The horizon is visible in the upper third of the composition alongside a minimalist sky with clouds.

artworks.title: Kneeling Woman from Behind
artworks.medium: watercolor and gouache over black chalk on brown paper
artworks.description: The image depicts the back view of a sitting woman from the waist up. Her head is slightly bent forward, facing away from the viewer. The visible portion of her face shows a partial profile, with her hair styled in a neat bun at the nape of her neck. She is wearing a long, dark-colored garment with voluminous sleeves gathered at the shoulders, and the material falls in pleated folds to form a full skirt. In her right hand, she appears to be holding a piece of light-colored fabric. The background is a plain, neutral-toned surface that highlights the sketch's details. Sketch lines are visible throughout the image.

artworks.title: The Count of Habsburg
artworks.medium: brown-gray ink and gray wash over graphite on wove paper, on old mount
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a medieval procession through a wooded landscape. The central figure is an elder riding a horse, dressed in a cloak and holding a staff. The horse is decorated, and other figures on foot accompany them, some with livestock. The figures are in medieval attire. In the background are mountains and a castle. The drawing uses black and white tones to create depth and texture.

artworks.title: Little Calais Pier
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in black on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a cityscape seen from a slightly elevated viewpoint along a waterway. The horizon line is near the top of the image, displaying buildings, including towers, chimneys, and a windmill. The artwork features a sketch-like style with dense, textured patterns in the sky and water. The color palette is muted, primarily black ink on beige paper. In the foreground, there is a wall or pier extending into the water, with a sailing vessel further out, leading to the distant urban skyline.

artworks.title: Thomas Haden of Derby
artworks.artist: Francis Seymour Haden after Joseph Wright
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is an etching of a seated person shown from the upper legs upwards. The individual rests their head on their hand with a contemplative expression. They have a strong nose and full lips, with wavy, shoulder-length hair. They wear a loose shirt and textured trousers. The background is filled with crosshatched lines.

artworks.title: Girl in a Modern Gown
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in black on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a woman standing in a doorway in a sketchy, etching style. She faces forward with her head turned to the right, hands clasped at her front. Her hair is tied back in a bun, and she wears a dark dress with a fitted bodice and a patterned skirt that is floor-length. The setting appears to be an interior space, framed by the doorway. Through the doorway, a chair is visible in front of a window with foliage seen outside. To the left, there is a vase with tall flowers on a shelf or table.

artworks.title: Study of an Arab Head
artworks.medium: Herkomergravure on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a head and part of the shoulders of an older man. The man's head is slightly tilted with a downward gaze. He has deeply set eyes, a prominent nose, a full beard and mustache, and textured hair and facial hair. He wears a cloth or turban around his head. The background is a simple, muted tone, and the artwork may be a sketch or etching.

artworks.title: Dancing Nymph with Bow and Arrows
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut in green and black on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a woman standing with her feet crossed as she steps on a helmet and a bow. Her arms are slightly bent outward, holding up a flowing garment around her knees. The woman's facial features include a direct gaze with delicately arched eyebrows and a subtle smile. Her hair is styled with curls that cascade around her face, adorned with floral decorations. She is dressed in a light, flowing dress with billowing sleeves, revealing her arms and shoulders. The fabric around her legs creates a voluminous appearance. No jewelry or accessories are visible, and she is not holding any additional objects. The background is plain and unadorned, emphasizing the figure and her posture.

artworks.title: The Death of Saint Peter Martyr
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene in a wooded area. The landscape is filled with trees and an open sky with clouds. In the center, a winged figure is descending from the sky. Below, several figures are among the trees, some in dynamic poses. Some figures appear to be engaged in dramatic activity. The foliage and clothing are detailed, highlighting the energy and beauty of the artwork.

artworks.title: The Miracle of Saint Mark (left side)
artworks.artist: John Baptist Jackson after Jacopo Tintoretto
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of multiple figures in various poses surrounding a central column. Some individuals are gesturing upward towards a figure in the top right corner with a bright halo or light behind them. Other characters are clustered around a person lying prostrate in the bottom center. Several figures are leaning from an architectural balcony, observing the scene below. Shadows and highlights are used to add depth to the scene. Line work and shading give texture to the interactions among the figures and architectural elements.

artworks.title: The Lion
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut on laid paper
artworks.description: This is an image showing a lion resting in a natural setting. The lion is depicted lying down against a rocky landscape with lush vegetation. The lion's mane is detailed and its expression appears calm yet regal. The background shows textured rocks and leafy trees, adding depth to the composition.

artworks.title: A Rock in the Sea
artworks.medium: wood engraving in black on japan paper
artworks.description: The image shows a seascape with turbulent waters beneath a vast sky. The horizon is high, with rocks and cliffs visible against it. A rock sticks out from the waves, holding a shipwreck. The sky is filled with clouds, painted with textured strokes for depth and movement. The color palette is grayscale, ranging from dark waters to lighter skies. The brushwork is detailed, creating a dramatic atmosphere.

artworks.title: Unfurled Waves, Flood of September, 1901 (Les Vagues deferlent)
artworks.medium: color woodcut on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a coastal scene viewed from a slightly elevated perspective, looking across the sea. The horizon is high in the composition, where the water meets the sky. The style resembles a woodblock print, with flat areas of color and stylized brushstrokes depicting the sea. The color palette includes browns, blues, grays, and whites. The beach is shown with foamy water receding, and a group of figures and a boat are silhouetted against the waves.

artworks.title: Girl in Peasant Costume
artworks.medium: etching in black on chine collé backed by wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a woman standing in a snowy landscape. She holds a basket and faces slightly left. She wears winter clothing and a bonnet. Snow covers the ground, and trees are in the background, along with a wooden fence.

artworks.title: 'Tween the Gloaming and the Mirk
artworks.medium: etching and roulette on Japanese paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape featuring a rustic wooden bridge over a waterway. The bridge leads to a path cutting through the terrain. A line of trees and structures, including a windmill, is visible on the horizon. The sky is cloudy, suggesting an impending storm or approaching dusk. The brushwork is intricate, creating texture in the scene and capturing reflections on the water. The color palette is dominated by sepia tones, with dark browns and earthy shades. The composition guides the eye from the water and bridge to the horizon.

artworks.title: Newark, N.J., from the Passaic
artworks.medium: etching in brown on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a riverbank scene with an industrial landscape in the distance. The horizon is high in the composition, merging with a pale sky. Factory buildings, smokestacks, trees, and a smoke plume are visible. The style is detailed with fine brushstrokes, in sepia tones. A path and a wooden pier are near the viewer, leading to the reflections in the river and the distant view.

artworks.title: Fishing Boats Tossed before a Storm
artworks.medium: watercolor with touches of gouache and pen and brown ink with gum arabic, over black chalk, with scraping and incising into wet paint on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Helen Porter and James T. Dyke

artworks.title: Harvest at San Juan, New Mexico
artworks.medium: etching in black on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape from a slightly elevated point of view. The view displays the land and the sky. The horizon line divides the earth from the sky. There are silhouette structures that resemble buildings or houses on the horizon. The style of the artwork is etching with fine lines creating patterns and textures. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of brown and black. A group of horses is galloping with figures holding whips. Clouds fill the sky, adding depth to the scene.

artworks.title: The Edge of the Swamp
artworks.medium: etching in black on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a frontal view of a dense forest with tall trees, some with leaves and some bare. The horizon is low, with a vast sky above the treetops featuring textured clouds. Fine brushstrokes depict the tree and grass textures. The foreground has various grass types with a bird. Past the trees, the landscape flattens, revealing some open space. The color palette is mainly sepia and brown.
